  children={"Activate a tree version"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/trees/{versionId}/activate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starts a processing job that validates every record label against the version, applies the successor mapping, embeds the category texts and re-derives the label paths. The active pointer moves only when the job succeeds; poll GET /job/status/\{guid\}. The job report lists valid, retired and missing codes with counts.

  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"description":"Tree activation options; both fields are optional. successorMapping maps a retired or missing category code to the active code its records move to and overrides the successors recorded in the tree.","properties":{"successorMapping":{"additionalProperties":{"type":"string"}},"allowMissing":{"type":"boolean","description":"Activate even when record labels name codes that are not in the tree; those records are excluded as evidence and listed in the report."}},"required":["allowMissing","successorMapping"],"title":"TreeActivationRequest"}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
